name: Mazanka Apartment, Kyiv (traced)
note: Traced by hand on the cached plan (1280 x 905 px). No scale bar, dimensions or areas: 75 px/m makes the outer wall outline about 98 m2 (the published area); traced net rooms 86 m2 (88%). Cross-checked with the furniture: double bed 129 x 143 px = 1.7 x 1.9 m, kitchen counter 43 px = 0.57 m, entrance door 68 px = 0.9 m, round table 1.2 m. Rooms at the inner wall faces; the bedroom/living partition and the bathroom/hall wall are put on one line (x 530). The bay's corner pier is kept, its curved glazing is two straight segments. The bedroom opens to the living room through a sliding door at the top of the partition; the walk-through wardrobe zone is part of the bedroom; the utility niche and ducts east of the guest WC are left out. Kitchen as drawn: base run with hob and sink on the partition, a tall-unit wall on to the entrance, tall shoe cupboards in the hall, an island with a lower table end.
